metadata.description: Product design skills by Raul Loureiro

plugins.name: design-skills
plugins.description: Seventeen skills for enterprise product design work. Start with either an evidence-backed problem frame or a short creative brief for aligning design meetings, explore solution directions inside a fixed time budget, then write a proposal someone can approve or decline. Other skills create briefs, breadboards, diagrams, wireframes, pitches, articles, slides and canvases. Utilities capture writing and visual style and strip AI tells from prose. UI Capture records live interfaces as replayable state maps, screenshots and interaction videos.
